title: Towards robust long-context understanding of large language model via active recap learning
abstract: arXiv:2601.13734v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: In this paper, we propose active recap learning (ARL), a framework for enhancing large language model (LLM) in understanding long contexts. ARL enables models to revisit and summarize earlier content through targeted sequence construction during continued pretraining and retrospective summarization at inference. First, we identify key tokens in prepared long context based on loss gaps between long and short forward contexts and find the most relevant preceding paragraphs, then summarize them using an LLM. Second, ARL equips models with the ability to autonomously generate and utilize these retrospective summaries during inference, thereby establishing a recursive memory mechanism across paragraphs. Experimental results show substantial gains, with ARL achieving an improvement of up to 129.7\% on RULER and 11--13\% on LongBench. translated_title: 通过主动回顾学习增强大语言模型对长上下文的鲁棒理解
translated_abstract: 本文提出了主动回顾学习，这是一个用于增强大语言模型理解长上下文能力的框架。ARL使模型能够在持续预训练阶段通过有针对性的序列构建来回顾和总结先前的内容，并在推理阶段进行回溯式总结。首先，基于长前向上下文与短前向上下文之间的损失差距，在准备好的长上下文中识别关键token，并找出与之最相关的先前段落，然后使用大语言模型对其进行总结。其次，ARL使模型具备在推理过程中自主生成和利用这些回溯式总结的能力，从而在段落之间建立起递归记忆机制。实验结果显示了显著的性能提升，ARL在RULER基准上取得了高达129.7%的改进，在LongBench上取得了11%–13%的改进。总体而言，ARL提供了一种简单而有效的基于持续预训练的方法，以增强模型的长上下文理解能力。
tldr: 提出主动回顾学习（ARL）框架，通过持续预训练中的针对性序列构建与推理时的自主回溯总结，使大语言模型在段落间建立递归记忆机制，显著提升长上下文理解能力（RULER提升最高达129.7%）。
en_tdlr: Proposes Active Recap Learning (ARL), a framework that enables LLMs to revisit and summarize earlier content via targeted sequence construction during continued pretraining and autonomous retrospective summarization at inference, establishing a recursive memory mechanism across paragraphs that substantially improves long-context understanding (up to 129.7% on RULER).
